\"EMPAT BEKAL. TIMUN, JARUM, GARAM, TERA: "FOUR PROVISIONS. CUCUMBER, NEEDLE, SALT, TERASI. NEVER STOP RUNNING."
...Ini. Kalau kau memang mau turun, kau: ...Here. If you really mean to go down there, you need this more than I do.
...Kau juga lari dari lumbung? Aku bisa: ...You ran from the granary too? I can smell straw and blood on you.
...Kau keluar dari lumbung. Belum pernah: ...You came out of the granary. No one has ever come out of the granary.
...Sudah. Untuk pertama kalinya sejak mu: ...It's over. For the first time since that season, I cannot hear his footsteps.
...Tumbal lepas... dari lumbung... Ladan: ...An offering... loose from the granary... The field hungers... the field always hungers...
...Yes. That sounds more like my daughter.
The Hearth Ash carries you home.
Abu yang membawamu pulang ke Tungku tera: Ash that carries you back to the last Hearth, whenever you wish.
Aku tidak lari lagi. Kali ini aku yang d: I am not running anymore. This time, I came to you.
Aku yang menempa rantai lumbung. Tiga pu: I forged the granary's chains. Thirty seasons, thirty children. I was paid in rice, and in silence.
Aku yang menjahit kepalanya dari labu, d: I stitched its head from a gourd, long ago, back when the village still believed it was only for frightening birds.
Ambil ini. Ramuan Jamu. Dulu ada perempu: Take this. A Jamu Draught. There was a village woman who always slipped one into an offering's hand... whether to help them, or to quiet her own heart, I cannot say.
The wind from there smells of iron and sap.
Angin lewat di antara batangnya dan berb: The wind passes between the stalks and whispers in many voices.
Aset: Sevarihk, Redshrike, Nidhoggn, Ken: Assets: Sevarihk, Redshrike, Nidhoggn, Kenney & others (see CREDITS.md)
Ayunan penuh tenaga. Perlu ancang-ancang: A blow with all your weight behind it. Needs a moment to wind up.
Bajumu bau jerami terbakar. Kau membakar: Your clothes reek of burnt straw. You put the field's guardian to the torch?
Bambu-bambu di sini tumbuh terlalu rapat: The bamboo here grows too close, too straight, like needles driven down from the sky.
Bara Tungku menyembur ke semua musuh. Ra: Hearth embers burst over every enemy. A long chant.
Barangku dari mana? Dari kantong-kantong: Where do my wares come from? From pockets that won't be needing them. Offerings have no use for supplies, do they?
Bau garam itu... Kau bertemu gadis di de: That smell of salt... You met the girl on the pier? My grandfather said she died seven seasons ago. In the village, we sing her name every harvest.
Bau udang membusuk menusuk hidung. Lumpu: The stench of rotting shrimp stings your nose. The mud of this mire is warm, and now and then it bubbles, as if breathing.
Bring the souls you take to those embers. The Hearth will turn them into strength. And lit Hearths call to one another, so long as the road between them is open.
Bawakan sukma dan bijih besi dari tanah: Bring me souls, and iron ore from that rotten land. I will forge your weapon. Call it a debt I am paying off.
Bekal kedua. Sebatang jarum emas yang du: The second provision. A golden needle that once grew a bamboo forest.
Bekal keempat. Bau busuknya dulu menengg: The fourth provision. Its stench once drowned a giant.
Bekal ketiga. Segenggam garam yang dulu: The third provision. A fistful of salt that once became a sea.
Bekal pertama Timun Mas. Hangat, berdeny: Timun Mas's first provision. Warm, pulsing, still hungry for soil.
Beristirahatlah di dekatnya bila tubuhmu: Rest beside it when your body breaks. But remember... each time you rest, the dead of this granary rise with you.
Beristirahatlah di sana bila tubuhmu rem: Rest there when your body breaks. Your draughts will refill, your wounds will close.
Good iron remembers every blow. So does this village.
Rotten cucumber seeds are sown into your flesh.
Biji yang dilempar si gadis emas... AKU: The seed the golden girl threw... I am its keeper. Return your flesh to the soil.
Bohong. Tapi terima kasih. Sudah lama ti: A lie. But thank you. It has been a long time since anyone cared enough to lie for me.
Bongkah besi hitam dari dasar rawa. Pand: A lump of black iron from the mire's floor. The village smith can work it.
Buahnya terlalu besar. Sebagian merekah,: The fruit has grown too large. Some have split open, and from within, something breathes.
Buto Ijo membuka mulutnya lebar-lebar. I: Buto Ijo opens its maw wide. It means to swallow you! Stop it, or evade!
Buto Ijo tenggelam untuk terakhir kaliny: Buto Ijo sinks for the last time.
CHEAT - untuk uji coba / cepat tamat (: CHEATS  -  for testing / a quick finish (the ending will remember)
Cakaran kuku hitam. Bisa membuat berdara: A rake of black nails. May cause bleeding.
DAN KAU, GADIS EMAS. SUDAH KUBILANG, TID: AND YOU, GOLDEN GIRL. I TOLD YOU. NO ONE RUNS FROM ME FOREVER.
DESA BERJANJI MEMBERIKANMU KEPADAKU. AKU: THE VILLAGE PROMISED YOU TO ME. I ONLY COLLECT WHAT IS OWED.
Damage yang diterima berkurang separuh s: Halves the damage you take until your next turn.
Dan bila kau mati, sukmamu tercecer di t: And should you die, your souls will scatter where you fell. Gather them before you die again.
Desa di atas sana menanam kita seperti b: The village above plants us like cucumber seed. When the season turns, Buto Ijo comes down to harvest.
The village did not merely give up its children. It arranged them.
Di balik ladang, bambu-bambu tumbuh rapa: Beyond the field, bamboo grows dense and sharp. The Needle Bamboo Forest awaits.
Di balik rumpun bambu ini terdengar suar: Beyond this thicket you can hear the village mortar. The stalks could be cut down.
Di bawah tangga terselip sebuah kendi. I: A clay jug is tucked beneath the steps. Inside: coarse salt, and a few souls clotted together like crystal.
Di bawahnya, dengan tulisan lain yang le: Beneath it, in a cruder hand: "He never stops chasing."
Di luar sel, sesuatu menyeret kakinya pe: Outside the cell, something drags its feet. This granary was never meant for rice.
Di pangkuannya ada sabit berkarat dan se: In his lap lie a rusted sickle and a scrap of cloth: "Do not harvest before it sings. If it sings, strike its head."
Di puncaknya terikat gelang benang merah: At the top is tied a bracelet of red thread, the same one they tied around your wrist before they carried you to the granary.
Di selatan, batang-batang bambu berdiri: To the south, bamboo stands packed tight, like needles driven into the earth.
This is where I threw the last provision. His lair lies to the south. Once we descend, there is no way back until one of us is dead.
Di ujung dermaga busuk, seseorang berdir: At the end of the rotting pier, someone stands staring at the water.
Di ujung timur ladang, sulur-sulur timun: At the field's eastern edge, the cucumber vines wither and fall. The way to the bamboo forest lies open.
Dingin. Bau timun busuk bercampur anyir: Cold. The smell of rotten cucumber, and beneath it, blood.
Dua ramuan tambahan. Ramuan bawaan tetap: Two extra draughts. Your own still refill at the Hearth.
Dua tusukan kilat. Bisa membuat berdarah: Two lightning thrusts. May cause bleeding.
Dulu aku melempar segenggam garam ke tan: I once threw a fistful of salt upon the earth, and the earth became this sea. The giant drowned... and then crawled out again.
Dulu jarum ini dilempar seorang gadis ya: A fleeing girl once threw this needle. The whole forest grew from the wound it made.
Before you were planted, you were...
Gadis yang dulu lolos dari Buto Ijo. Kin: The girl who once escaped Buto Ijo. No longer wholly alive.
Gelombang air garam menghantam semua law: A wave of brine crashes over every foe.
Gerbang lengkung di ujung lorong menuju: The arched gate at the corridor's end leads to the hall. There burns a Hearth: embers that never die.
Gesit; bertindak lebih sering. Membawa s: Nimble; acts more often. Carries stolen souls.
A filthy bite that may poison.
Gigitan rahang belalang yang merobek kul: Locust mandibles that tear the skin.
Goresan kuku memenuhi dinding. Sebagian: Fingernail scratches cover the wall. Some are already lost beneath the moss.
Gundukan tanah kecil dikelilingi bambu y: A small mound of earth ringed by bamboo grown in a circle. A golden needle is driven into its peak.
HMMMM... BAU TIMUN... BAU TUMBAL YANG LE: HMMMM... I SMELL CUCUMBER... I SMELL AN OFFERING LOOSE FROM MY GRANARY...
Ia lari, membawa empat bekal yang kuseli: She ran, carrying the four provisions I pressed into her hands. Ever since, this village has paid for her escape with other children.
Ia mengangkat senjatanya tinggi-tinggi s: It raises its weapon high before every blow. That is when it is open.
Ia merentangkan tangan dan mulai menemba: It spreads its arms and begins the harvest song... Stop it before it ends!
Jala nelayan yang membusuk melilit tubuh: A rotting fishing net winds around your body.
Jalan setapak ke timur menuju Ladang Tim: The footpath east leads to the Rotten Cucumber Fields. A sweet, rotting smell drifts in on the wind.
Jalan setapak tertutup sulur timun yang: The path is choked with writhing cucumber vines. Something in the middle of the field holds them there.
Jangan berdiri di situ seperti hantu. Du: Don't stand there like a ghost. Sit by the Hearth. I lit its embers with jackfruit wood and... other things.
Jangan lihat palunya. Lihat tanganmu sen: Don't look at the hammer. Look at your own hands. There are rope marks there, aren't there?
Jangan menatapku begitu. Aku tidak memin: Don't look at me like that. I do not apologise to offerings.
Jangan mendekat! ...Oh. Kau bukan dia. K: Stay back! ...Oh. You're not him. You're only an offering.
Fingers of straw rake you twice.
Jemari kecil itu dingin dan kaku. Kamu m: The small fingers are cold and stiff. You open them, one by one.
Jerami terbakar habis. Di antara abunya,: The straw burns away. Among the ashes, something glints gold.
Kadang aku lupa namaku sendiri. Yang kui: Some days I forget my own name. All I remember is the rice mortar, pounding on harvest nights.
Kamu beristirahat di Tungku. HP pulih, R: You rest at the Hearth. HP restored, Jamu Draughts refilled.
Kamu menebas bambu sampai tanganmu berda: You hack at the bamboo until your hands bleed. The glow of the village Hearth appears at the end of the path.
You leave it be. For now.
Kamu terbangun di atas jerami basah. Tal: You wake on wet straw. The palm-fibre rope around your neck has snapped, its frayed end still damp with something.
You slide down a slope of mud. Above you, the way back closes.
Kau bertemu dengannya. Jangan bohong, ak: You met her. Don't lie to me. I can smell the salt in your hair.
Kau masih di sini? Sarangnya di tenggara: You're still here? The lair is to the southeast, where the path slopes down. Once you descend, the mud won't let you climb back.
You carry my provisions. The seed, the needle... I will come. Call for me at a Hearth when you need me.
You... you should be in his belly by now. Take this, and go before anyone else sees you.
Kemajuan sejak terakhir menyimpan akan h: Progress since your last save will be lost.
Kendi minyak jarak yang dilempar dan ter: A jar of castor oil, thrown to burst into flame. 90 fire damage.
Kendi minyak jarak yang menyala. Kuat me: Burning jars of castor oil. Strong against straw things and insects.
Kendi tanah liat kosong. Menambah satu w: An empty clay jug. Adds one more Jamu Draught flask.
Kepala desa menyuruhku memastikan Buto m: The headman sent me to make sure Buto still sleeps. If he wakes before the harvest, the village must send two children, not one.
The terasi pool at the heart of the lair churns. Something very large sleeps beneath it.
Kolam terasi terbelah. Kepala hijau sebe: The terasi pool splits apart. A green head as large as a house rises, followed by two hands that seize the edge of the mud.
Strong, and hard to bring down.
A small rusted key from Buto's granary.
Ladang di timur tumbuh dari biji timun y: The field to the east grew from the cucumber seed my daughter threw. Its soil still remembers the taste of flesh. The bamboo forest to the south was once a handful of needles.
Ladang timun terbentang sampai ke kegela: The cucumber field stretches into the dark. Its vines climb the bamboo stakes like veins.
Lantai di depan penuh retakan. Sesuatu y: The floor ahead is riddled with cracks. Something large breathes in the darkness of the upper hall.
Lari ke mana? Ladang, hutan bambu, laut,: Run where? The field, the bamboo, the sea, this mire... all of it grew from that girl's provisions. Every land around the village is the trail of her flight.
Laut ini tidak berombak. Airnya pekat, a: This sea has no waves. Its water is thick, salt enough to sting the eyes, and not a single bird flies above it.
Lolongan dari dalam labu kering membuat: A howl from inside the dried gourd sets your knees shaking.
A rotten spell that leaves the body fragile.
Masih di sini, Nak? Lumbung ini lapar. J: Still here, child? This granary hungers. Do not let it chew you twice.
Mayat seorang anak, meringkuk menghadap: The corpse of a child, curled toward the wall. Its fingers are clenched around something.
Looses a soul as an arrow.
Membalas setiap serangan fisik x1.5 samp: Answers every physical attack at x1.5 until your next turn.
Restores the HP of one ally.
Memulihkan separuh HP. Terisi ulang seti: Restores half of your HP. Refilled whenever you rest at a Hearth.
Mengangkat gada tinggi-tinggi... lalu me: Raises the club high... then brings it down. Brace yourself!
Menghindari semua serangan sampai gilira: Evades every attack until your next turn.
Wields the arts of the soul.
Menunggu. Selama Buto lapar, desa akan t: Waiting. As long as Buto hungers, the village will keep planting children. I am too tired to run again, and not yet brave enough to go back.
Menyapu semua musuh dan menunda giliran: Sweeps every enemy and pushes back their turns.
Menyembuhkan racun dan darah yang tak be: Cures poison and blood that will not stop flowing.
Namaku Timun Mas. Desa memujaku sebagai: My name is Timun Mas. The village worships me as the child who survived. They do not know that since that day, I have never truly lived.
Napas busuk udang fermentasi menyelimuti: A breath of fermented shrimp rot smothers every foe.
Orang bilang ia tenggelam di rawa terasi: They say he drowned in the terasi mire. Giants do not drown, child. They simply stay hungry longer.
Orang memanggilku Mbok Srini. Dulu aku p: They call me Mbok Srini. I had a daughter once. Her skin was gold, like a cucumber ripened on the vine.
The scarecrow does not move. Then its dried gourd of a head turns to face you.
A black beak pecks at open wounds.
Pembeli! Sudah lama sekali. Orang desa t: A customer! It's been so long. The villagers don't buy anything. They only pray, and pound.

The fisherman's door is barred from within. Through the gaps in the planks drifts the smell of salted fish long since turned to dust.
Pukulan ke kepala: menunda giliran targe: A blow to the head: pushes the target's turn far back.
Pulanglah ke desa, Tumbal. Katakan pada: Go home to the village, Offering. Tell Mbok Srini: no one else needs to be planted.
Rahang bangkai buaya terbuka lebar... la: The crocodile carcass opens its jaws wide... then snaps shut.
Raksasa itu tenggelam untuk terakhir kal: The giant sinks for the last time. The terasi pool dries into a black crust.
The giant's roar shakes the mire.
A roar that withers the courage.
Ribuan jarum bambu berjatuhan ke semua l: A thousand bamboo needles rain upon every foe.
Satu benda yang kau genggam saat ditanam: The one thing you clutched as they buried you:
Sebongkah terasi kering terbungkus daun: A block of dried terasi wrapped in banana leaf, untouched by the mud around it.
Sebutir biji timun, hangat seperti baru: A single cucumber seed, warm as if freshly picked. It pulses faintly in your palm.
Segenggam abu Tungku. Membawamu kembali: A handful of Hearth ash. Returns you to the last Hearth.
Segenggam garam bekal Timun Mas: membaka: A fistful of Timun Mas's salt: sears unseen things and breaks their chants.
Semua jalan terbuka (%d) dan semua Tungk: All paths opened (%d) and every Hearth lit.
Senjata ini sudah ditempa sampai batasny: This weapon has been forged to its limit.
Your weapon cannot be forged any further.
Seorang petani duduk bersandar di ajir,: A farmer sits against a stake, his straw hat over his face. He stopped breathing long ago.
A plain strike with your weapon.
Simpan ke slot (mati tidak pernah menyim: Save to slot (death never saves automatically):
Sisa sukma seorang anak tumbal. Pecahkan: What remains of a child offering. Crush it to gain 40 souls.
Sukma pekat seorang penjaga lumbung. Pec: The dense soul of a granary warden. Crush it for 200 souls.
Sukma pekat seorang penjaga: 200 sukma u: A warden's dense soul: 200 souls to grow stronger early.
Sukma yang kamu bawa tercecer di tempat: The souls you carried lie scattered here.
Sukma, sukma. Di desa ini cuma itu yang: Souls, souls. In this village, that's the only coin that counts.
Sulur timun mengikat semua musuh dan mem: Cucumber vines bind every enemy and slow them.
Sulur timun yang menggeliat menutup jala: Writhing cucumber vines bar the way. Something in the middle of the field holds them there.
Tangan kanan mengangkat gada tinggi-ting: The right hand raises its club high... Delay it or break it before it falls!
A giant's hand crushes your body.
Tapi di kejauhan, lesung desa masih berb: But in the distance, the village mortar still pounds. Tok... tok... tok...
Tapi lesung di Karangtumbal masih berbun: But in Karangtumbal, the rice mortar still pounds.
Tentakel membelit dan menyeret giliranmu: Tentacles coil around you and drag your turn back.
Terima kasih sudah bermain. [Z] kembal: Thank you for playing.   [Z] return to title
Terlalu rapat untuk ditembus dari sisi i: Too dense to break through from this side.
Tidak ada jalan keluar dari sebuah pelar: There is no way out of an escape. Only a longer road.
Timeline (Doubly Linked List), head = gi: Timeline (Doubly Linked List), head = next turn:
Timun Mas bergabung. Bekal ketiga: Garam: Timun Mas joins you. Third provision: Timun Mas's Salt
Timun Mas waits at the Hearth.
Timun Mas is already with you.
Tok... tok... Jangan bicara padaku. Anak: Tok... tok... Don't speak to me. My child was harvested two seasons ago. I still pound for him.
Tok... tok... tok... Lesung tidak boleh: Tok... tok... tok... The mortar must never stop. If it falls silent, he knows someone has run.
Tubuhnya merekah, menyemburkan getah bus: Its body splits, spraying rotten sap over every foe.
Tulang-tulang kecil ditumpuk rapi sepert: Small bones, stacked as neatly as rice in a granary. Far too neat to be the work of a giant.
Tumbal tiga musim lalu. Buto tidak suka: An offering, three seasons past. Buto has no taste for old meat, so they left me here to rot.
Tungku ini tidak pernah padam. Kalau pad: This Hearth never goes out. If it ever did, this village would remember everything it has done.
